headline: Oil Prices Slip as US and Iran Explore Middle East Peace Talks
summary: Oil prices closed lower as markets reacted to reports of renewed diplomatic efforts between the United States and Iran to achieve a settlement in the Middle East conflict.
why: Geopolitical negotiations involving major oil-producing nations or transit corridors influence global risk premiums embedded in energy commodity contracts.
why_moved: Reports of potential diplomatic resolutions ease concerns over imminent supply disruptions, leading commodity traders to sell off previous risk-driven gains.
